fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.36.1 keeps the v0.36.0 mirror-only OCum model unchanged and fixes a free-scene alignment regression on remote mirror threads: the temporary XMarkerHeading scene anchor is now recognized as a virtual anchor rather than physical furniture, so the continuous STR proxy pose guard is disabled and OStim root motion remains authoritative. Physical furniture and wall scene guards remain unchanged.
